name: alpine-ascents
description: Alpine Ascents: premium mountaineering expedition SPA (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap 5, jQuery + Node/Express)

scripts.postinstall: npm run pages && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: npm run pages && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run pages && npm --prefix client run setup && npm start --prefix server
